description: This file defines a utility enum 'SessionKey' with static methods for processing and validating session key strings, used in session management within the application.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string to a session key, defaulting to 'main' if input is empty or only whitespace.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string for an agent, combining agent ID and base key, with trimming and defaults.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given session key string is a canonical main session key, such as 'global' or starting with 'agent:'.
